# Goswami Vishal Nathdwara

Goswami Vishal Nathdwara (also known as Vishal Bawa) is an Indian spiritual leader, motivational speaker, social entrepreneur and author.
Subsequent to an amendment by the Rajasthan Government, he has been made the Ex-officio member of the Shrinathji Temple Board, which amendment shall take force once it receives assent from the President of India. The temple was built by Goswami Dauji II.
Goswami Vishal Nathdwara has been the key figurehead in all temple visits for notable figures, including the Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, the Indian billionaire businessman Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani, Minister of Home Affairs Shri Amit Shah, Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh Shri Yogi Adityanath, and many other notable figures. He has bestowed his blessings upon them, wishing them success during these visits.
He has spoken at cultural festivals across various countries including India, UAE, Bahrain, USA. He took the onus and spreading the teachings of Pushti through India and the globe.
Goswami Vishal Nathdwara is the most prominent figure of Nathdwara, Rajsamand district, Rajasthan.
He plays a crucial role in enhancing the state of Shrinathji's gaushalas, which are located across Mewad and serve as an integral element of daily seva.
Early life
Goswami Vishal Nathdwara was born in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. He is the son of Goswami Tilakayat Shri Rakeshji Maharaj, the senior pontiff and chairman of  the Shrinathji Temple board in Nathdwara and the first direct descendant of Shri Vallabhacharya.
